claims.text: LLMiser turns each sheet into a ## heading and a Markdown pipe table, in workbook order
The hidden Q3 old sheet was converted with no note that it was hidden
The Read me title line became the table's only column header; units lived only on Read me
ZIP codes stored as text, e.g. 02134, came out as 2134 because every value looked numeric
A number formatted to display as 00123 came out as 123; text 00123 survived in a mixed column
Excel keeps 15 significant digits and turns later digits into zeros; 16+ digit codes need text format
The 19-digit ID shown as ...230000 came out as 4012345678901230080
Exporting the sheet to CSV and converting the CSV kept the zeros
Output carries the last saved formula result; app-saved file showed 126.00, 3,750.00 and total 3,876.75
The script-written copy without cached results showed NaN for every formula cell
Merged North cell: second row NaN; blank row NaN with NaT in the date column; totals row empty except Amount
The bar chart had no trace in the output
Colors, comments and pictures do not come through as cell values
claims.note: Chart verified by fixture; colors, comments and pictures inferred from the value-only reading path, not separately tested.

claims.text: LLMiser accepts .xlsx and .xls up to 15 MB; both become one table per sheet
